item.text: {"search_note":"I found little clean evidence of AMLO publicly retracting a false 2024 claim on his own initiative. The strongest positive material is mostly about procedural acceptance of elections and one concrete police-abuse admission, not a broader habit of correction. The negative material is stronger: repeated denial, blanket dismissal of criticism as lies or calumny, attacks on journalists, and institutional pressure on oversight and reporting.","evidence":[{"title":"Accepted election results / public information framing","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-06-05","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presentan-resultados-de-elecciones-en-conferencia-del-presidente-se-requiere-garantizar-el-derecho-a-la-informacion-afirma/","summary":"AMLO publicly presented the preliminary presidential results and framed the moment around public access to information rather than denial or destabilization. This is a limited positive sign for truthfulness when the outcome no longer protected him.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Vote-by-vote recount and deference to electoral authority","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-06-20","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/","summary":"He said a vote-by-vote recount was the best way to remove suspicion and that one should respect what the electoral authority decides. This is another narrow pro-truth / pro-process signal.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"No reelection / orderly transition","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-06-25","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/25-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/","summary":"AMLO said he would not seek reelection and would leave office, which is a concrete statement about relinquishing power that he did not reverse.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Admitted police repression in Veracruz","publisher":"El Economista","date":"2024-07-16","url":"https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/politica/AMLO-acepta-represion-violenta-en-Veracruz-informa-que-hay-dos-detenidos-20240716-0024.html","summary":"He said police used violence against protesters, said they should not have acted that way, and said two officers were detained. This is one of the clearest 2024 examples of acknowledging state misconduct.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Ayotzinapa case still being worked","publisher":"Secretaría de Gobernación","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/presidente-amlo-entregara-informe-a-madres-y-padres-ayotzinapa-con-anexos-que-sustentan-cada-respuesta-370094","summary":"The government said it had searched 251 sites, handled 141 cases, and was still working the Ayotzinapa case with families. This is limited positive evidence of continued investigative activity rather than closure-by-denial.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Right of reply to false claims","publisher":"Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism","date":"2024-06-17","url":"https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico","summary":"Xóchitl Gálvez obtained a court-ordered right of reply to false claims AMLO had made about her. That is direct evidence against a clean “truthful and self-correcting” record.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Doxxing-style attack on a journalist","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-26","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-president-lambastes-youtube-after-company-edits-video-revealing-nyt-journalists-number-3314584","summary":"AMLO revealed the New York Times bureau chief’s phone number on broadcast, then accused YouTube of censorship after the platform removed the video. This is strong evidence of punishing or intimidating truth-tellers rather than correcting himself.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Repeated attacks on journalists and media","publisher":"Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism","date":"2024-06-17","url":"https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico","summary":"The overview says his final year featured regular verbal attacks on journalists, human-rights advocates, and the media. That is hostile to truthful reporting and consistent with a blame-the-messenger pattern.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"“Vil calumniador” / “pura calumnia” line on critical reporting","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-03-13","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/13-03-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/","summary":"AMLO called a ProPublica journalist a “vil calumniador” and said critical reporting on him was lies and calumny. This is direct evidence of doubling down rather than correcting or engaging substantively.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"“Todos, absolutamente todos” are lies","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-04-29","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/29-04-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/","summary":"He rejected a set of allegations as “a compendium of lies with political purposes” and denied them all. This is strong evidence of blanket denial and blame-shifting rather than correction.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"“Alarmism” defense of policy continuity","publisher":"Presidencia de la República 2018-2024 / Gobierno de México","date":"2024-06-04","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/economia-de-mexico-es-solida-y-hay-responsabilidad-en-manejo-de-finanzas-presidente/","summary":"When confronted with market concern and criticism, AMLO dismissed it as alarmism and insisted the policy would not change because it had already worked. This is more deflection than admission of error.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Blocking access-to-information oversight","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico","summary":"HRW says AMLO and his party blocked appointments to INAI, leaving the transparency body unable to function normally. That undercuts truthful reporting and public correction by weakening the main information watchdog.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Covert monitoring of critics","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House reports a covert SEDENA cyberspace unit monitored critics and used inauthentic accounts, while the government expanded surveillance with little oversight. This is strong negative evidence on allowing truthful reporting.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Journalists under protection still being killed","publisher":"Amnesty International / CPJ","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/mexico-killings-journalists-strengthen-federal-mechanism/","summary":"Even journalists in the federal protection mechanism were still being killed, showing the state was not effectively protecting truth-tellers.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"INE overhaul seen as political hegemony play","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-06-04","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906","summary":"Reuters reported AMLO’s INE overhaul was seen as a way to cement Morena’s hegemony and lower the bar for referendums. That is negative evidence on whether he allowed truthful institutional constraints to stand.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Judicial overhaul weakened independent constraints","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-09-15","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588","summary":"Reuters reported the overhaul weakened judicial independence. That matters for this lens because it made it easier to avoid accountability and harder for truthful challenges to stick.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]}]}
